narrative.intro: Regents of the University of California has $162M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Regents of the University of California received 1 award so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $162M. Current-year totals are partial, because the period covers fiscal year to date. Obligations fell 87.7% year over year. Historical obligations show year-to-year scale: FY22 totaled $6.7M, FY23 totaled $982M, FY24 totaled $1.4B, FY25 totaled $1.3B, FY26 totaled $1.3B, and FY27 to date totaled $162M. Regents of the University of California has a high concentration of current-year obligations in a single award, and FY2027 to date represents a smaller slice of the multi-year pattern recorded since FY22.

sections.heading: How has federal contracting trended for Regents of the University of California?
sections.body: Regents of the University of California obligations rose from $6.7M in FY22 to $982M in FY23, then to $1.4B in FY24, and then held near $1.3B in FY25 and FY26. Regents of the University of California obligations fell 87.7% year over year in FY27 to date, to $162M.
